posts.title: Musk, Karp, Zuck, and Dario Walk Into a Political Compass
posts.summary: I made an AI-specific political compass because “left” and “right” are useless labels for companies. For example, Musk and Karp are both right-wing while disagreeing on almost everything that actually matters in AI.

posts.title: The Second Cognitive Revolution
posts.summary: We have taught machines our greatest trick: language. Like a jet engine spun up by a starter motor, biology got human intelligence to a point of self-sustainment. Now, we have done the same for AI.

posts.title: Rumours of Google’s demise have been greatly exaggerated
posts.summary: Google’s biggest enemy in the the AI-race is Google itself, but even Google can’t stop Google from winning eventually.

posts.title: Is anybody really using Claude Fable 5?
posts.summary: How Anthropic ran through its goodwill faster than it takes Fable 5 to burn $1,000 in tokens, and why almost nobody is using it for work.

posts.title: An Introduction to Rohaan's Ramblings
posts.summary: After years of avoiding online writing, I’m starting this space because I miss the simple act of putting my own thoughts into words. This will be a Non Generative AI Zone: both my writing and my thoughts will be unfiltered.
